substeps.caption: The Kardex Shuttle XP 500 quoted in #53: 2450 × 864 mm trays in a 2780 × 3074 mm module, 3950 mm tall to stay under 13 ft. The base frame goes down first, on levelling feet.
Posts and roof rails. The posts at the middle of each side mark off the three bays: front storage, the extractor's shaft and rear storage.
Storage columns. Trays rest on supports on a 25 mm pitch (drawn every 100 mm here), so a tray takes only the height its equipment needs. The front column leaves a gap for the access opening.
The extractor: guide rails in the shaft, the drive on the roof frame (motor, cross shaft, two belt pulleys), then the platform on its belts. It carries one tray at a time.
Three electrified trays (#53): strong (1080 lb), medium (794 lb) and light (502 lb). Each has a power strip and a socket; it has power in its slot and at the opening, not while it moves.
Cladding, the access opening with its light curtains and LED bar, the operator console, and the powered safety shutter behind the front panel. The panels are drawn see-through.
